parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space by opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the door, shelves, and base.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom base panel of the cabinet made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and stabilizes the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the storage space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an upper storage surface inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
